Name: Qiaozisang newly added furniture
Author: qiaozisang
Description:
[b]简介[/b]
1：模组目前包含6张床、8块地毯、5个浴缸、1个马桶
2：模组会持续更新，请不要将模组转载出这个网站，如果您对此模组有任何疑问，请与我联系，联系方式：[url=https://space.bilibili.com/1870070?spm_id_from=333.1007.0.0]巧子桑[/url]
3：CP模式家具需要[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI、[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]、[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] 这几个模组，只能用[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]找到我们的额家具
FF模式家具需要[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI、[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url]这几个模组，你可以在原版家具目录中找到我们的家具
4：浴缸搭配[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7334]Sit For Stamina[/url]可以达到泡温泉的效果
[b]
1.1.5版本更新：[/b]
1：感谢由猫柚chocolate提供的FF模式家具，FF模式家具比CP模式家具增加了一些功能
2：FF模式和CP模式没有冲突，两个模式可以共存

[b]FF模式的改变[/b]：
1：双人床的两边可以坐和放置物品
2：浴缸是一个整体，不在需要用4个浴缸拼在一起
3：小浴缸由之前的像床一样走进去，变成了椅子的坐上去
4：所有的家具都可以放置在室外
[b]
特殊情况：[/b]
由于床可以坐，当床紧靠墙面时，坐下然后起来有可能会卡进墙里，我已经做过了调整，现在这种情况出现的概率应该会很小，如果出现这种情况需要重新开启游戏或者使用任意传送道具。

[b]brief introduction[/b]
1: The module currently includes 6 beds, 8 carpets, 5 bathtubs, and 1 toilet
2: The mod will continue to be updated. Please do not repost the mod from this website. If you have any questions about this mod, please contact me at [url=https://space.bilibili.com/1870070?spm_id_from=333.1007.0.0]巧子桑[/url]
3: CP mode furniture requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI、[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]、[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]  modules, and we can only use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] to find our furniture
    FF mode furniture requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI、[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url] modules. You can find our furniture in the original furniture catalog
4: Bathtubs paired with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7334]Sit For Stamina[/url] can achieve the effect of soaking in hot springs

[b]Version 1.1.5 Update:[/b]
1: Thanks to the FF mode furniture provided by 猫柚chocolate. FF mode furniture has added some functions compared to CP mode furniture
2: There is no conflict between FF mode and CP mode, and both modes can coexist

[b]Change in FF mode:[/b]
1: Both sides of the double bed can be used for sitting and placing items
2: The bathtub is a whole and does not require four bathtubs to be pieced together
3: The small bathtub changed from walking in like a bed to sitting on a chair
4: All furniture can be placed outdoors

[b]Exceptional case:[/b]
Since the bed can be used for sitting, when it is close to the wall, sitting down and then getting up may cause it to get stuck in the wall. I have made adjustments, and the probability of this happening now should be very small. If this situation occurs, you need to restart the game or use any teleportation item.
